title: Proximity-verification policy
description: The proximity-detection bands accepted for verifying a physical hand-off on this order, committed at agreement signing. Each band corresponds to a standard short-range detection technology — Wi-Fi presence, Bluetooth Low Energy, ultra-wideband ranging, or NFC contact. Multi-valued: the designer commits the set the assembly accepts; an order carrying no proximity-policy clause requires no proximity verification. The runtime proof that a hand-off actually occurred within an accepted band is a separate attestation concern, produced at hand-off time — not part of this agreement-time policy.

fields.name: bands
fields.label: Detection bands
fields.description: The proximity-detection technologies the assembly accepts, ordered loosest to closest. zone-wifi = same Wi-Fi network (presence within an access point's coverage). nearby-ble = Bluetooth Low Energy proximity (~metres). precise-uwb = ultra-wideband ranging (IEEE 802.15.4z / FiRa; decimetre-accurate distance at range). contact-nfc = NFC tap (near-contact, ~centimetres). At least one must be set when this clause is present.
